top_signals.title: UN mission finds evidence signaling U.S. war crimes in Iran; Washington rejects report
top_signals.summary: The UN mission pointed out the missile strike on a primary school that killed over 150 people, as well as another airstrike which killed 22 civilians.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
